note: Alberta Parks recreation area 25 km north of Crowsnest on the Forestry Trunk Road, in mature forest near Racehorse Creek and the Livingstone Range; no firewood for sale. OHV riding on designated trails in the vicinity. The bridge to the trails across the creek from the campground was swept away by high water (advisory effective June 30, 2026). --Claude
summary: AP page read: 38 FCFS unserviced sites C$26, season May 15 - Oct 1 (matches the manual season), no potable water, Information phone 403-627-1165; riverview kept; OHV wording is 'designated trails in the vicinity' only.
flags: OHV: the park page lists 'OHV riding : designated trails in the vicinity.' No staging area, trail system or OHV zone named for the campground itself; the camping page does not mention OHVs. Not a drop candidate by the rule (general campground with OHV riding nearby); reported for the reviewer.

WATERFRONT riverview: confirmed, not upgraded. Racehorse Creek runs along the west side; the west loop road is ~30-55 m from the creek channel/gravel bar through open pine forest, spurs on its west side perhaps 15-25 m from the bar, but no campground map exists to number sites. Without site numbers recommend keeping riverview. The page calls it 'a peaceful creek side campground' (marketing; not used in the note).
PIN 49.83335,-114.42266 is at the campground entrance off the Forestry Trunk Road (AP directions point 49.833551,-114.423623); loops lie within ~150 m west/north - OK.
